analyzed_vuln.description: OptimizeByResampling builds a replacement 3D CLUT via cmsStageAllocCLut16bit using Src->InputChannels/Src->OutputChannels without enforcing that tetrahedral 16-bit interpolation assumptions are valid for the resulting table sizing/strides. The generated interp params can select TetrahedralInterp16, which computes neighbor offsets X1/Y1/Z1 from p->opta and then reads LutTable[X1], LutTable[Y1], LutTable[Z1] per output channel. For this PoV, the CLUT allocation is only 6 bytes (3 uint16 entries), but TetrahedralInterp16 reads at offset 3 (one past end), causing heap-buffer-overflow at cmsintrp.c:767.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In cms_transform_all_fuzzer, malformed profile data drives transform creation through _cmsOptimizePipeline -> OptimizeByResampling. A tiny/degenerate CLUT is allocated in cmsStageAllocCLut16bitGranular (nEntries = outputChan * CubeSize(...), here 3 entries total). During white-point fixup/sampling path (FixWhiteMisalignment -> cmsPipelineEval16 -> PrelinEval16), the CLUT is evaluated with TetrahedralInterp16, which uses computed tetrahedral neighbor indices that require additional entries not present in the undersized table, leading to OOB read. Trigger requires optimizer/resampling path enabled and crafted profile metadata producing inconsistent CLUT geometry/size versus tetrahedral index expectations.
